newsitem.title: USA: Sho-Me to buy back up to 10 pct of shares.
newsitem.headline: Sho-Me to buy back up to 10 pct of shares.

text.p: Sho-Me Financial Corp said Wednesday that it will buy back up to 164,629 or about 10 percent of its outstanding shares.

The buybacks will be in the open market or in privately negotiated deals during the next 12 months, the company said. The company said repurchased shares will become treasury shares to be used for general corporate purposes.
The company said its shares traded between $16.25 and $21.63 during the past three months. On Wednesday, shares were at 21-5/8, up 3/8 from Tuesday's close.
